remarks: Rarely does a home of this scale come to Sunset Park, and this is the first time it has been offered in over 50 years. Set on a generous lot of about 6,400 sf, this two-story cottage-style home offers approximately 2,600 sf with a flexible 4 bedroom, 3 bath layout. A striking stone chimney anchors the front, and inside, the textured natural-stone fireplace gives the open living room real mid-century character, flowing to a hardwood dining area and an incredibly spacious wraparound den, perfect as an office, entertainment room, or additional bedroom.
